newsitem.title: GERMANY: El Al adds FRA-LAX freighter drops CGN-NY.
newsitem.headline: El Al adds FRA-LAX freighter drops CGN-NY.

text.p: Israeli national carrier El Al has launched a weekly Tel Aviv to Los Angeles Boeing 747 freighter service via Frankfurt and New York.
The airline's cargo manager forGermany, Arno Billing, said El Al had taken advantage of the new cut-price freighter landing fees at Frankfurt to switch the New York service from Cologne airport.
He told Reuters in an interview: "This is the only direct freighter connection from Frankfurt to Los Angeles and our first freighter from Frankfurt to the USA."
The westbound flight, which started on November 2, is on Saturdays, while a different aircraft is used for the return Sunday New York to Frankfurt and Tel Aviv flight, he added.
The airline already flies a weekly Frankfurt to Tel Aviv service on Tuesdays and has thus doubled its Germany to Israel capacity, he said.
"We thought about doing this (service) because of the Frankfurt night fees. Up to now, Frankfurt did not have such a pro-freighter policy," Billing stated.

Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) has cut the night landing fee for freighters by 50 percent to try to encourage airlines to add extra services from Germany's cargo gateway and to avoid losing services to cheaper airports such as Paris or Amsterdam.
"Next year we might perhaps add a second freighter from Frankfurt," he added.
But El Al still had traffic rights at Cologne for the U.S. although it was not currently using them, Billing stressed.

Demand for the new freight route is good and the space split between Tel Aviv and Frankfurt is flexible, with a pick-up in New York for Los Angeles, he said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
